title: Saudi Beef Stew
description: A hearty stew originating from Saudi Arabia, perfect for a cold winter day. This recipe combines tender beef with aromatic spices and velvety potatoes.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add the Saudi Arabian spice blend, thyme, salt, and pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef broth and potatoes to the pot. Stir to combine.
Return the beef to the pot and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the oven. Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
